summary.work_completed: Implemented the full NFR-REL-001 Auto-Save Crash Durability feature. Created 7 production files: dbSchema.ts (IndexedDB schema with types, validation, and DB initialization), persistenceService.ts (atomic dual-store writes with quota-exceeded recovery), crashRecoveryService.ts (boot-time crash detection with snapshot validation), persistenceStore.ts (Zustand store for auto-save state management), useAutoSave.ts (interval-based auto-save hook with beforeunload listener), ResumePrompt.tsx (accessible modal dialog with data-testid attributes), and index.ts barrel export. All implementations satisfy the 10 test cases from the TDD test suite.
key_findings: Atomic dual-store IndexedDB writes use a single transaction spanning scene-snapshots and auto-save-meta stores
Crash detection validates snapshot integrity (bricks array, schema version) before offering recovery
Quota exceeded handling purges oldest snapshots (keeps latest 10) then retries the write
ResumePrompt uses role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby for WCAG compliance
All required data-testid attributes are present: resume-prompt, resume-prompt-brick-count, resume-btn, discard-btn
